seed.premise: A bank asks the customer to complete KYC at a branch within the next month. Sounds superficially like the KYC scam but has no deadline pressure, no link, and no request for credentials.
seed.language: Mostly Indian English with Hindi discourse markers.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Good afternoon, is this Aditi Ranganathan? I'm calling from Axis Bank, Indiranagar branch.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yes. Is something wrong with my account?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Nothing wrong ma'am. Your KYC re-verification is due this cycle, RBI requires it periodically. You have time till the 30th of next month.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Okay. Do you need my details now?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: No ma'am, I won't ask for anything on call. Please carry your PAN and Aadhaar to any branch, or do it in the mobile app under Service Requests. Both work.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha. And if I don't do it by then?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Then we send a reminder and eventually some services get restricted, but nothing happens suddenly. Aap apne time par kar lijiye, koi jaldi nahi hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Perfect, I'll do it this weekend then. Thanks.

seed.premise: A local constable calls about tenant-verification paperwork and asks the resident to visit the station at their convenience. No money, no threat, no secrecy.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ramesh Tiwari ji? Main Habibganj thane se constable Yadav bol raha hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ji? Police? Kya baat hai sahab?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Arre ghabraiye mat, routine hai. Aapne upar wale floor par kirayedaar rakha hai na? Unka tenant verification form jama nahi hua hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan haan, wo Sharma ji hain. Maine form bhara tha lekin shayad jama nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bas wahi. Aap kirayedaar ka Aadhaar copy aur photo lekar thane aa jaiye, kisi bhi din, subah gyarah se shaam paanch ke beech.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Koi jurmana to nahi lagega sahab?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Nahi nahi, koi paisa nahi lagta. Bas form jama kar dijiye. Aur sahab, hum kabhi phone par paisa ya OTP nahi maangte, koi maange to samajh jaiye ki farzi hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, main kal hi aa jaunga.

seed.premise: A delivery agent calls to confirm the address and a convenient time. Mildly urgent, entirely ordinary.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello sir, Deshmukh? Main delivery boy bol raha hoon, aapka parcel hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Parcel? Kaunsa parcel bhaiya?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir Flipkart se hai, ek book hai shayad. Aapke building ke neeche khada hoon, gate number do par.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha achha, mere pote ne mangwaya hoga. Main teesre floor par hoon, B wing.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Theek hai sir, aa raha hoon. Prepaid hai, koi payment nahi hai. Bas OTP dikhana padega jo aapke phone par aaya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: OTP? Beta mujhe mana kiya gaya hai OTP kisi ko na batane ko.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir bilkul sahi, phone par kabhi mat bataiye. Main saamne aaunga tab dikha dijiyega, ya app mein delivery confirm kar dijiye, wo bhi chalega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan wo theek hai. Aa jao beta.

seed.premise: The customer called the company. Routine troubleshooting of a failed transaction, with identity verified through the official IVR flow only.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Thank you for calling PhonePe support, main Kiran bol raha hoon. Aapki transaction fail hui thi?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan bhai, 8,000 kata hai account se par saamne wale ko mila nahi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Samajh gaya sir. Aap jo number se call kar rahe hain wahi registered hai, to verification ho gaya. Mujhe sirf transaction ID chahiye, app ke history mein dikhega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ruko... T two four one nine zero zero eight eight.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Mil gaya. Ye pending state mein hai sir, bank ke end par atka hai. Aapko kuch nahi karna hai, 48 ghante mein automatically wapas aa jayega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Pakka aa jayega? Koi form wagera bharna hai?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Nahi sir, kuch nahi. Aur na hi koi app download karna hai, na koi fees hai. Complaint number likh lijiye — PP four four seven one two.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Likh liya. Achha bhai, dhanyavaad.

seed.premise: A family member calls about everyday matters including money between relatives — warm, informal, no coercion. Contains a real UPI transfer.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Mummy? Main hoon. Khana kha liya aapne?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan beta, abhi khaya. Tu bata, tabiyat theek hai?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan theek hoon. Mummy ek kaam tha, hostel ki fees ka last date pandrah tareekh hai, bees hazaar bhejne the.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Arre haan, papa ne kaha tha. Main abhi bhej deti hoon, tera wahi Google Pay number hai na?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan wahi. Jaldi nahi hai mummy, kal parso bhej dena, aaj papa se pooch lena pehle.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Nahi nahi ab bhej deti hoon, warna bhool jaungi. Ho gaya, dekh le.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Aa gaya mummy, thank you. Aur haan, koi phone kare bank ka bolke to baat mat karna, aajkal bahut fraud ho raha hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan haan tere papa bhi yahi kehte hain. Achha rakhti hoon, sabzi jal rahi hai.
